questions.question: How many bachelor's degrees were conferred on females in the 2019-20 academic year?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_degrees_conferred.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2022 Table 318.10', header=None)
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('2019-20')].iloc[0]
result = int(row[9])

questions.question: In which academic year did female students first earn more than 50 percent of all doctor's degrees conferred?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_degrees_conferred.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2022 Table 318.10', header=None)
data = df.iloc[4:68].copy()
data[19] = pd.to_numeric(data[19], errors='coerce')
first_row = data[data[19] > 50].iloc[0]
result = str(first_row[0]).strip()

questions.question: How many reported academic years prior to the 2000-01 school year had women receiving more than half of all master's degrees?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_degrees_conferred.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2022 Table 318.10', header=None)
data = df.iloc[4:68].copy()
idx_2000 = data[data[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('2000-01')].index[0]
data_prior = data.loc[:idx_2000 - 1].copy()
data_prior[15] = pd.to_numeric(data_prior[15], errors='coerce')
result = int((data_prior[15] > 50).sum())

questions.question: Which three academic years saw the highest total number of associate's degrees conferred between 2010-11 and 2015-16?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_degrees_conferred.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2022 Table 318.10', header=None)
data = df.iloc[4:68].copy()
data[0] = data[0].astype(str).str.strip()
years = ['2010-11', '2011-12', '2012-13', '2013-14', '2014-15', '2015-16']
sub = data[data[0].isin(years)].copy()
sub[1] = pd.to_numeric(sub[1], errors='coerce')
top3 = sub.sort_values(by=1, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].tolist()
